name: Uruguay
dossier:
The Uruguay national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the La Celeste, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 16 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CONMEBOL to this expanded 48-team tournament.

History's original champions, still snarling, still punching far above their weight.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Uruguay will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group H and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group H. The connection between Federico Valverde and Darwin Núñez is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Federico Valverde - the clinical midfield who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Uruguay are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Uruguay, a nation of 3.4 million, has won as many World Cups as England, France and Spain combined  -  two stars on the shirt.
Uruguay boast 2 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Champions (1930, 1950).
